items.title: Game Off 2026: The theme is SHIFT
items.blurb: GitHub’s annual month-long game jam is back for its 14th year! This November, make a game inspired by the theme SHIFT. Change gears, swap perspectives, bend reality, or just press a certain key.

items.title: Arnis turns any place on Earth into a Minecraft world
items.blurb: Louis Erbkamm built the first prototype in his free time. Now GitHub Copilot helps him maintain it alone. The post Arnis turns any place on Earth into a Minecraft world appeared first on The GitHub Blog .

items.title: LLVM Vulkan 1.1: Drop-in compiler passes (GVN, CSE, CFG, DCE) on Vulkan compute with benchmarks & Clang integration
items.blurb: Hey r/programming and r/Compilers , I've just released LLVM Vulkan 1.1 , an open-source project that moves beyond an experimental prototype into a drop-in pass plugin that accelerates LLVM middle-end passes using portable Vulkan compute…

items.title: Introducing Zero Wire, a hub for investigating critical Internet vulnerabilities
items.blurb: Zero Wire on Cloudflare Radar pairs plain-language briefings with global attack telemetry and remediation steps. Triage critical CVEs faster and decide how to protect your infrastructure.
